item.title: Upgrading to OpenEMR 8.2.0
item.description:

Upgrading to OpenEMR 8.2.0

Backup first

Before starting any upgrade, take a full backup of:

  • Your OpenEMR sites/ directory.
  • The OpenEMR database.

Prerequisites

  • A working OpenEMR 8.1.0 installation.
  • PHP 8.2 or newer (you may need to upgrade PHP before upgrading OpenEMR itself).

Upgrade steps

  1. Download the openemr-8.2.0.tar.gz tarball.
  2. Extract the tarball alongside the existing installation; do not overwrite the existing sites/ directory.
  3. Browse to https://your-server/openemr-8.2.0/sql_upgrade.php and run the upgrade.
  4. Update your web server document root to point to the new release.

After upgrade

  • Verify the version number on the OpenEMR login page.
  • Review the release notes for post-upgrade configuration steps.
